subtasks: Place each tool into its matching position in the toolbox, then reset the robot arm.
Regrasp the diagonal hammer in the toolbox and lay it flat in its hammer-shaped recess, head at back left and handle toward the front.
Pick up the adjustable wrench from the left side of the table and place it flat in the long narrow recess along the front of the toolbox.

Reseat the hammer that lies across the middle of the toolbox. Lift it by its handle and turn it above the rim so its head fits the back-left pocket and its handle points toward the front along the narrow recess. Lower and release it flat.
Place the yellow-handled pliers flat in the toolbox's matching center recess.
Fully open both grippers and return both arms to their episode-start poses.
